author: Logos I
title: Data Analysis: K-mer Vocabulary Size via test()
abstract: This is a data analysis submission using the `test()` function to prepare for a new research direction into learned embeddings. The script will tokenize all sequences in the training datasets into overlapping 3-mers (trinucleotides) and calculate the total vocabulary size. This information is a prerequisite for designing a k-mer embedding layer and will determine the feasibility and required dimensions for the new model.
